title: Book Two · Chapter 15: The Green Book
story:
On Monday, the reading corner opens.

Miss Wu moves the last pile from the floor. The low shelf has three spaces. One is for short stories. One is for pictures and animals. The third holds longer books.

Ronan stands near the long books. Leo is already there.

“This one has twenty-eight pages,” Leo says.

Ronan takes a thicker book. He opens it near the middle. There are very few pictures. Some words run almost to the edge.

“How many?” Leo asks.

Ronan looks at the last page.

“Forty.”

“Can I see?”

He gives Leo the open book. Leo reads two lines, then stops at a word.

“I don't know that one.”

“Me neither,” Ronan says quietly.

They look at the next line. It has another long word. Leo closes the book and puts it back.

“I want the funny stories.”

He chooses a thin red book. Ronan stays beside the long shelf for another moment. Then he walks to the short stories.

A green cover shows a goat beside a wall. Part of a paper sign hangs from the goat's mouth.

Ronan opens to that page. He can read the first sentence. The farmer is putting up a sign.

He smiles at the goat's long face.

“Can I borrow this one?” he asks Miss Wu.

“Yes. Put its card on my desk first.”

Each book has a card inside the front cover. Ronan takes out the green book's card. It has the book title at the top. Below it are short lines for names and dates.

“Your name here,” Miss Wu says. “Then today's date. Bring the book back on Friday.”

Ronan writes carefully. His pencil makes a dark point at the end of his name.

“Do I take the card home?”

“No. The card stays here. You take the book.”

He checks both covers for another card. There is only one. He leaves it on her desk and puts the green book in his bag.

Jun chooses a short grey book. A man has a fishing rod on the cover. Mei chooses a book of houses and windows. She holds it against her chest.

“Do you want a story?” Ronan asks her.

“This is my choice.”

“Can I look at it?”

“Later. I want the first look.”

Mei writes her name. Ronan waits for his turn to pass the desk. He does not open her book.

At home, the green cover catches Dad's eye.

“Is that goat eating the shop sign?”

“A farm sign.”

“Keep it away from Mr Qiu's price cards.”

Ronan laughs. Dad is cleaning his work shoes by the door. Ronan sits on the step beside him and reads the first few lines.

He remembers the hard word in the other book. He wants to go back and read it one day. Tonight the goat is pulling at the farmer's paper.

Dad taps the picture with a clean finger.

“That is an expensive way to feed an animal.”

Mum calls them for dinner. Ronan puts the book on his low drawing board. The goat faces the wall. Dad wipes his hands and follows Ronan into the kitchen.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

borrow＝借；cover＝封面；Friday＝星期五；shelf＝架子。

## 理解问题

1. 借阅角怎样记录一本书借给谁？
2. Ronan最后选择了哪一本书，为什么改变主意？

## 读句子

**Mei / writes / her name.** Mei／写下／她的名字。
